messages:
aditya: Quick proposal — I sketched a new synthetic generator called 'stochastic-envelope' for shaping long-tail latency + a replay harness that enables apples-to-apples kernel/batching comparisons. Goal: reproduce microbursts, sustained tails, and KV warmup effects in one configurable harness.

kevin: Love the idea. Two asks: 1) make the client model include small fanout (1-3 parallel reqs) so batcher sees realistic burstiness, 2) expose a warmup curve so we can test different KV prefill policies.

sasha: Also want a 'kernel-lock' toggle to force the runtime to pick the same kernel family as prod when doing comparisons. Otherwise small kernel switches can mask real perf deltas.

maria: Important: replay harness must normalize prompt-length and stop-token distribution. If input length distribution diverges, the runtime takes different attention paths and results are not apples-to-apples.

aditya: Agreed. Initial config prototype (json):

```
{
  "envelope_period_ms": 30000,
  "peak_qps": 1200,
  "base_qps": 50,
  "spike_prob": 0.12,
  "spike_multiplier": 8,
  "client_fanout": [1,2,3],
  "kv_warmup": "prefill", // options: prefill | on_demand | hybrid
  "kernel_lock": true,
  "seed": 20260318
}
```

ci-bot: /ci triggered: perf/replay-stochastic-envelope --seed=20260318 --baseline=20260228 --compare-kernel-lock=true :gear:

kevin: When you run, collect: token-level batching histogram, per-model-kernel usage, kv_hit_rate_by_shard, and per-request latency buckets. Example command: `./perf/run_replay --config cfg.json --metrics kv,batched_hist,latency`

sasha: FYI we recently saw a regression where changing backpressure thresholds bumped p99 by ~15% under bursty load. This harness should catch that if we toggle spike_multiplier and kernel_lock.

maria: Suggested metrics set: p50/p95/p99, tokens_per_request, avg_batch_size, kv_miss_penalty_ms, kernel_switch_count. Also record trace IDs for top-100 slow requests.

aditya: Thanks — I'll land a PR with the generator and the replay adapter. Plan: run apples-to-apples vs current replay-baseline tomorrow, then a sweep across kv_warmup modes. Please review PR #412 and add synthetic prompt sets you want included. :rocket:
